name: Editorial
description: Magazine typography. Ivory serif headlines, a lime accent, marker highlights.
vibe: An editorial magazine come to life. Ivory text, serif display headlines, one lime accent used sparingly. Captions in a clean grotesk with the key word underlined in lime. Hook title as a serif headline with one accent word (*stars*). Use marker-highlight for the key phrase, quote-card for the strongest line, chapter-title when the topic shifts. Calm smooth zooms. No emoji or GIFs. Every graphic should look like it belongs on a printed page.
